summary: Invardia support keeps read-only access by default, and each PIM component can move to its own identity safely.

fixes.title: Support access stays read-only
fixes.text: Invardia support keeps read-only database access, with admin rights only inside an open support session.

fixes.title: As-built document reaches support directly
fixes.text: A private installation's as-built document reaches Invardia support straight from the installation, checked on arrival, with no outside access to its storage.

fixes.title: Managing tenant builds clean up after themselves
fixes.text: A managing tenant build removes its own temporary database admin membership when it finishes.

fixes.title: Each component can move to its own identity
fixes.text: A new script moves each PIM component to its own identity, proving the new one works before any old right is removed.

fixes.title: Simpler hybrid worker deploy
fixes.text: The hybrid worker deploy script is now one self-contained, checked file.
